name: manual_arabic_naturalness_grammar_review
method: manual prose read of compact title/text snapshots; only high-confidence MSA grammar, case-form, idiom, and naturalness defects are repaired; stylistic preferences alone are not edits

post_pass07_recheck.note: All 28 A1 passages expanded after the original Pass11 read were re-read in current ending context. Nine high-confidence tense, event-order, logic, or MSA-idiom defects introduced by the Pass07 append-only expansions were repaired with literal-source, metadata, lexical-occurrence, and band guards; Pass07 remained at zero review flags after repair.

a1.note: Original full A1 Pass11 review plus targeted post-Pass07 current-text recheck are complete; current canonical A1 prose is covered by naturalness review evidence.

post_pass07_recheck.note: All 38 A2 passages expanded after the original Pass11 read were re-read in current ending context. No additional high-confidence grammar, idiom, tense-continuity, event-order, or naturalness defect was found; stylistic-only alternatives were left unchanged.

a2.note: Original full A2 Pass11 review plus targeted post-Pass07 current-text recheck are complete; current canonical A2 prose is covered by naturalness review evidence.

b1.note: Full B1 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 B1 passages had completed Pass-03/07 length and assessment recalibration. Exact passage-scoped repairs were assertion-guarded; stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

b2.note: Full B2 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 B2 passages had completed Pass-03/07 length and assessment recalibration. The full pass applied 21 exact assertion-guarded repairs across 20 passages; the total also includes one earlier independently detected comparative-naturalness repair in ar-b2-u04-p06, which was subsequently reviewed again in the full pass. Stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

c1.note: Full C1 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 C1 passages had completed Pass-03/07 length and assessment recalibration. The repair batch applied 29 exact high-confidence MSA grammar/idiom/collocation repairs across 23 passages; assessment, new-target, review-target, and literal new-target occurrence contracts were assertion-guarded. Stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

c2.note: Full C2 manual prose read was performed only after all 60 C2 passages had completed structural/length and assessment recalibration. The full manual batch applied 64 exact high-confidence MSA grammar/idiom/collocation repairs across 42 passages. The total also includes the earlier guarded مبرر lexical-sense normalization in ar-c2-u01-p03 and the pre-snapshot removal of a residual Latin-script intrusion in ar-c2-u01-p02, for 66 repairs across 43 unique passages. The batch assertion-guarded assessments, speed-training metadata, new/review target metadata, literal target occurrence counts, the 700–1200-word band, and Arabic-only reader-facing title/text. A fresh post-repair snapshot revalidated all 60 passages at 709–977 words. Stylistic-only alternatives were intentionally left unchanged.

post_pass07_revalidation.coverage_metric_note: Pass07 lexical coverage remains UNMEASURED, reported separately from actionable review flags.
